title: Spec: CLI Integration
summary: Defines bb-harness CLI with subcommands: validate, ingest, state-diagram, regression-graph, heatmap, gate, export (testrail/xray/notion), import (testrail/xray), run (forward-test). Documents PLAN-CLI-01 (verbose), PLAN-CLI-02 (import integration), PLAN-CLI-03 (forward-test wrapper), PLAN-CLI-04 (docs/tests). All plans completed 2026-05-30.
